policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: Each episode starts with A, press button: the initial scene has no held cube and remaining_targets is null. If remaining_targets is still null and no completed reveal is available, choose A.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: Give holding a cube priority: if a cube is held, choose C, place the cube onto the table. Otherwise, if remaining_targets is None and no completed reveal is available, choose A, press button.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: When remaining_targets is a nonempty list and the gripper is empty, choose B, pick up the highlighted cube, targeting the currently visible table cube corresponding to the first stored coordinate.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: When remaining_targets is a nonempty list and the gripper is empty, choose B, pick up the highlighted cube, targeting an unpicked member of remaining_targets. Follow any pickup priority explicitly supplied by the goal instruction or current observations; absent such a priority, any remaining member is admissible. Serialization order does not establish pickup priority.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: This selects the blue cube near [89, 146] in episode 6, the green cube near [64, 91] in episode 28, the red cube near [81, 125] in episode 38, the blue cube near [84, 92] in episode 57, and the green cube near [99, 104] in episode 98.
After placement, an empty gripper and a nonempty remaining_targets list lead back to B for its first entry; never pick up an already removed cube again.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: After placement, an empty gripper and a nonempty remaining_targets list lead back to B for an unpicked member selected by the same rule; never pick up an already removed cube again.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: For other unmodeled situations, choose C if holding a cube, otherwise B at the first remaining target if one exists, otherwise A only when remaining_targets is null.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For other unmodeled situations, choose C if holding a cube, otherwise B at a remaining target selected by the same rule if one exists, otherwise A only when remaining_targets is None.

edits.modify_from: Initialize to null when the incoming memory is empty.
edits.modify_to: Treat an empty incoming memory, a missing or blank remaining_targets field, or None as uninitialized. Write the literal sentinel None if no button reveal is available; never leave the field blank or write null.

edits.modify_from: If the incoming value is null and the frames show the button-press interval and white highlighted areas, associate each highlighted area with the cube immediately above or overlapping it and record that cube's table center as [y, x].
edits.modify_to: If the field is uninitialized and the frames show the button-press interval and white highlighted areas, associate each highlighted area with the cube immediately above or overlapping it and record that cube's table center as [y, x].

edits.modify_from: Order targets by image columns from smaller x to larger x; cubes whose x coordinates differ by at most 10 pixels count as the same column and are ordered by increasing y.
edits.modify_to: Order targets by image columns from smaller x to larger x; cubes whose x coordinates differ by at most 10 pixels count as the same column and are ordered by increasing y. This is a serialization convention only, not a pickup priority.

edits.modify_from: An unsuccessful closure or temporary disappearance is not sufficient for removal. Placement does not add an entry back.
edits.modify_to: An unsuccessful closure, temporary disappearance, or observation of an already-held cube is not sufficient for removal. Placement neither removes an entry nor adds one back. Preserve an occluded remaining target while another cube is released.

edits.modify_from: An empty list means all revealed targets have been picked up; null means the reveal has not yet been recorded.
edits.modify_to: Write [] only after all revealed targets have actually been picked up; None means the reveal has not yet been recorded.

edits.modify_from: Before the button-reveal interval has been observed, use null rather than an empty list.
edits.modify_to: Before the button-reveal interval has been observed, write the literal sentinel None, never a blank value, null, or an empty list.

edits.modify_from: Order targets by image columns from smaller x to larger x; cubes whose x coordinates differ by at most 10 pixels count as the same column and are ordered by increasing y.
edits.modify_to: Order targets by image columns from smaller x to larger x; cubes whose x coordinates differ by at most 10 pixels count as the same column and are ordered by increasing y. This is a serialization convention only, not a pickup priority.

edits.modify_from: At each decision following a successful pickup, remove the picked cube.
edits.modify_to: At each decision whose supplied execution interval shows a listed cube grasped at its table location and subsequently lifted while held, remove that cube. Release or placement of an already-held cube does not establish a new pickup.
Use [] only once all revealed targets have been successfully picked up.

revision.refused: No unsupported smaller-x, color, episode-specific, or future-action-derived pickup priority is committed. Admitting any remaining highlighted cube removes the contradicted first-entry rule but does not settle exact recorded-object prediction: that still requires an independently supported priority or evaluation accepting any remaining target. No extra memory field, placement-time deletion, or requirement to recover an unseen exact pixel point is committed; the existing target list and grasp-and-lift removal criterion suffice for retaining and locating occluded unpicked targets.
